Compared with SKWINSPX skevent.cpp::ACTUATE_DOOR and all Firestaff owners. Live and GAME_LOAD candidate paths apply the source open/closed/intermediate action gates, store DoorBit09 as 1=open/0=close with source byte order, and reverse an already-moving door without queueing a duplicate step timer. Partial: the GAME_LOAD candidate path still rejects occupied-door chains; creature collision effects and party collision parity outside the bound live timer path remain incomplete.

Compared with SPX skevent.cpp::STEP_DOOR and Firestaff live/candidate owners. Live path follows DoorBit10, source-endian DoorBit09, and queues continuations from the popped timer's source tick. It handles a closing door over the party using the active G1 door graphic's GDAT strength, ATTACK_PARTY pending wounds, per-hit champion bump sounds and delayed sound timers, plus the source's extra tick. It also handles non-immune creatures whose AI threshold admits the current door state through ATTACK_CREATURE/CAII, source door-strength HP delta and immunity bit, state decrement, creature-hit/knock delayed sounds, and extra tick. Live mutations roll back on admission failure. Partial: PARTY/creature collision does not yet run on non-current maps without an active G1 door mapping; GAME_LOAD candidate party/creature collisions remain fail-closed; exact audio/resource edge parity remains to verify.

Compared with SPX skgame.cpp::ACTIVATE_ACTION_HAND. Firestaff validates a living in-party hero and hand range, then updates active hero/hand before redraw. It does not gate selection with IS_ITEM_HAND_ACTIVABLE, nor mirror glbSelectedHandAction/glbSelectedHand_2, glbSomeChampionPanelFlag, glbMagicalMapFlags, CHAMPION_SQUAD_RECOMPUTE_POSITION, UPDATE_RIGHT_PANEL, and REFRESH_PLAYER_STAT_DISP source effects. The source activability helper exists elsewhere but is not wired into this click path.

Remaining parity is unverified for all sound-queue edge conditions and platforms.
